workflow selects among GET /translate/{task_id}, /transcribe/{task_id}, /dub/{task_id}, and /sub/{task_id}; one operation cannot select more than one route.
Source and target languages are two JSON GETs (/source-languages and /target-languages); one operation cannot select both routes.

notes: Live https://docs.composio.dev/toolkits/camb_ai (slug CAMB_AI, version 00000000_00) lists Tools: 8 and Triggers: 0. Triggers were not counted. composio_tools is the live count 8. index_tools is 8. The counts match. origin/main has no runner/connectors/camb-ai/manifest.json, so origin_ops is 0. Official auth is header x-api-key at https://client.camb.ai/apis (OpenAPI server and https://docs.camb.ai/getting-started/authentication). allowedHosts is ["client.camb.ai"] only. No caller host or base URL. CAMB_AI_LIST_VOICES is GET /list-voices, whose 200 body is a JSON array wrapped under data; the endpoint has no query parameters, so Composio's local name, gender, language, and publication filters are not sent. CAMB_AI_TRANSLATE_TEXT is POST /translate JSON and returns task_id. CAMB_AI_GENERATE_SUBTITLES is POST /sub JSON and returns task_id. CAMB_AI_DUB_MEDIA is POST /dub JSON (video_url in the body) and returns task_id. Those three creates do not poll and do not download audio or video bytes. Formality is the documented integer 1 (formal) or 2 (informal). GET_TASK_STATUS, GET_RUN_RESULT, and LIST_LANGUAGES each select more than one route. TRANSCRIBE_MEDIA is multipart. mapped 4 + missing_http 0 + missing_still 4 = 8.
